reviews.title: Quality fans and easy installation
reviews.comment: Another great product from NZXT. They are always are the forefront of peripheral design, and the F420 is not exception. Turning a bulky and cumbersome triple fan intake setup into a single frame with 1 wire is amazing. RGB looks great and noise levels are low. Recommend!
reviews.author: Tyler rohrman

reviews.title: Great quality for the money and they look nice
reviews.comment: For what seemed like a good idea at the time I built my PC using 140MM fans and a 280MM AIO cooler...not realizing how limited in options for radiator fans.  I wanted a nice pair of RGB fans for my radiator but could not find a nice one to my liking that was designed for radiators.  I tried regular RGB fans (plenty of those in 140mm) which looked great but they were made for airflow and just didn't do the trick against my radiator, temps were still higher than I wanted. High static fans in that size in RGB are far more limited in selection and the "best" were about $45 each, these I got for half of that and they work awesome.  Temps are down, quiet noise and they look awesome. The only complaint I have is that the fans have very low LED count, (only 8 per fan, most have at least 16+) and they cant be controlled individually, both fans are seen as one.  Outside of that I couldn't be happier and I highly recommend them if you want something made to go against a radiator

reviews.title: Quality
reviews.comment: Paired with the hub and a Nzxt H6 flow case. Awesome design and really simple to install. Absolutely quite and the color settings are nice. Quality fans.
reviews.author: Toby

reviews.title: Works great paired with NZXT Kraken X63.
reviews.comment: The F280mm paired up nicely with the NZXT Kraken X63 AIO. Easy to install 4 screws instead of 8. I thought the side windows would be brighter but it’s not too bad. Overall it gave my wife’s PC a good look compared to the non rgb fans the AIO came with originally. Thumbs up 👍🏻
reviews.author: Rodrigo Gonzalez

reviews.title: Great fan!
reviews.comment: This is probably the best fan you can get for your case. Only needs one system fan connecter and a 5V rgb connector and you can use it for your case. Only reason i give this a 4 star is because amazon sent me a 240 mm first so i had to get another one. Pros: Excellent airflow for intake or exhaust 3 Fans in one frame so it only needs 4 screws to hold in (screws are included with the fans) RGB looks good no issues with the RGB Fits perfectly in most cases Easy to install all you need is a screwdriver Cons: Pricey Sells out quickly Noisy fresh out of the case but you can change the rpm in the bios or through the fan controller
